accent.objective: Focus on rhythm and pitch. Sound exactly like a native speaker. Practicing this helps you speak clearly so everyone can easily understand you.
accent.tip: PRO TIP: Over-enunciate! Emphasizing the vowels helps clear up minimal pair confusion.
accent.title: Phonetic Drill

accentShadowing.objective: Listen to the speaker and choose the right answer. Once you've got it, grab your mic and try repeating the sentence exactly how they said it.
accentShadowing.tip: PRO TIP: Don't stress about being perfect! Just focus on the melody and how the words flow together.
accentShadowing.title: Accent Shadowing

accentshadowing.objective: Speak clearly to match the exact accent and rhythm of the speaker. Practicing this helps you speak clearly so everyone can easily understand you.
accentshadowing.tip: PRO TIP: Pay close attention to which syllables are stressed — it makes a huge difference!
accentshadowing.title: Accent Shadowing

alphabet.objective: Listen to the instruction and tap the correct letter block to reveal a fun word on the chalkboard.
alphabet.rule_0: Tap the chalkboard to hear the instruction
alphabet.rule_2: Tap it to reveal the word
alphabet.tip: Pro tip: If you get stuck, tap the chalkboard question mark again to hear the instruction as many times as you need!
alphabet.title: Alphabet Game

ambientId.objective: Sharpen your situational awareness by identifying environments solely through their ambient soundscape, essential for real-world immersion. Practicing this trains your ears to understand native speakers effortlessly.
ambientId.tip: PRO TIP: Close your eyes and visualize the scene! Focus on ambient sounds like footsteps, echoes, wind, or humming machinery.
ambientId.title: Spatial Anchor

animals.objective: Read the riddle to figure out the animal, and tap or drag the matching picture into the binoculars!
animals.rule_2: Tap or drag it to the binoculars
animals.tip: PRO TIP: Listen to the fun animal sounds when you find the correct answer!
animals.title: Animal Safari

antonymSearch.objective: Identify the core word's exact opposite and snap it into the center core to fuse them. Then, speak the pair aloud to confirm your answer.
antonymSearch.rule_1: Snap the opposite word into the core
antonymSearch.tip: PRO TIP: Antonyms are completely opposite concepts. If the core says 'hot', you're looking for 'cold' to neutralize it!
antonymSearch.title: Antonym Search

articleInsertion.objective: Choose the correct article ('a', 'an', or 'the') to complete the sentence. Getting these small words right helps your spoken English sound much more natural.
articleInsertion.rule_1: Decide if the noun is specific
articleInsertion.tip: PRO TIP: Use 'the' when talking about a specific thing, and 'a' or 'an' when talking about something in general.
articleInsertion.title: Article Orb

audioFillBlanks.objective: Listen to the audio feed and type the missing words in the transcript. Practicing this trains your ears to understand native speakers effortlessly.
audioFillBlanks.tip: PRO TIP: Listen carefully to short helper words like 'a', 'the', 'in', or 'at'!
audioFillBlanks.title: Ink Decoder

audioMultipleChoice.objective: Let's train your ears to catch every word! Tap the center to listen to the sentence, then spin the radar to find the missing word that fills in the blank.
audioMultipleChoice.tip: PRO TIP: If you miss the word the first time, you can always tap the center to listen again!
audioMultipleChoice.title: Audio Radar

audioSentenceOrder.objective: Let's put the puzzle pieces together! Listen closely to the speaker and build the exact sentence by placing the scrambled words in the order you hear them.
audioSentenceOrder.rule_1: Find the first word you hear
audioSentenceOrder.rule_2: Snap the words together in order
audioSentenceOrder.tip: PRO TIP: Don't just guess the grammar! Listen closely to the rhythm and how the speaker links words together.
audioSentenceOrder.title: Sentence Builder

audioTrueFalse.objective: Listen to the audio clip and decide if the statement is true or false. This trains your brain to catch small but important details in everyday conversations.
audioTrueFalse.tip: PRO TIP: Pay close attention to the exact words used in the audio. A tiny detail can change the whole meaning!
audioTrueFalse.title: True or False?

body_parts.objective: Time for a quick checkup! Read the symptoms on the doctor's clipboard, and place the healing bandage on the correct body part.
body_parts.tip: PRO TIP: Can you point to that body part on yourself?
body_parts.title: My Body

branchingDialogue.objective: Drag the decision probe to choose what to say next! Every choice changes how the conversation flows and affects your relationship with the characters.
branchingDialogue.tip: PRO TIP: Pay attention to the relationship meter! The best response depends on who you're talking to and how they're feeling.
branchingDialogue.title: Social Simulator

clauseConnector.objective: Drag the correct connector to link the two clauses. Connecting short sentences makes your English flow much more naturally in real conversations.
clauseConnector.tip: PRO TIP: Think about the relationship. Does it show a result, a contrast, or does it add information?
clauseConnector.title: Clause Connector

clothing.objective: Let's solve some fun clothing riddles! Listen carefully to the clue, find the matching clothing tag, and hang it in the closet.
clothing.tip: PRO TIP: If you missed the clue, just tap the glowing closet to hear the riddle again!
clothing.title: Clothing Riddles

clozeTest.objective: Read the sentence and find the missing word. You'll drag or tap your answer, then prove you know it by spelling it out! This builds both your reading speed and vocabulary.
clozeTest.rule_1: Tap or drag the best word
clozeTest.tip: PRO TIP: Try to guess the missing word before checking the options. And get ready — you have to spell it to lock it in!
clozeTest.title: Fill the Blank

collocations.objective: Drag the correct word bubble to the anchor to form a natural English collocation, then build a sentence using it.
collocations.rule_1: Drag the bubble that pairs best
collocations.rule_2: Build a sentence with the pair
collocations.tip: PRO TIP: Native speakers use these pairs naturally. Don't translate word-for-word, think about what sounds right!
collocations.title: Collocation Match

colors.objective: Look at the color word on the easel, then drag the matching color or item onto the canvas.
colors.tip: Tip: Think about things you see every day that match the color.
colors.title: Learning Colors

completeSentence.objective: Read the fragment and launch the missing word into the blank to finish the thought.
completeSentence.tip: PRO TIP: Trust your ear! If the sentence sounds incomplete when you say it out loud, it probably is.
completeSentence.title: Complete Sentence

conditionals.objective: Tap the correct consequence to finish the sentence, then type the full sentence to lock it in! This helps you naturally practice how to talk about imaginary situations and real-world consequences.
conditionals.tip: PRO TIP: When talking about an impossible or imaginary present situation (like 'If I were you'), we use 'were' instead of 'was'!
conditionals.title: What If?

conflictResolver.objective: Read the scenario, tune the dial to find the most helpful response, and speak it out loud to de-escalate the situation.
conflictResolver.rule_1: Tune the dial to a response
conflictResolver.tip: PRO TIP: Pay attention to the person's feelings before choosing your response on the dial.
conflictResolver.title: Peace Maker

conjunctions.objective: Drag the correct connector to build a bridge between the sentence halves, then type the full sentence to lock it in! Linking your thoughts smoothly makes your English sound much more natural.
conjunctions.rule_1: Drag a bridge to connect them
conjunctions.rule_2: Type it out to lock it in
conjunctions.tip: PRO TIP: Read both halves out loud. Does the second half add information, contrast, or give a reason? Let that guide you to the right connector!
conjunctions.title: Logic Junction

connectedSpeech.objective: Native speakers naturally link words together. Discover how the sounds merge, shift, or disappear, then speak the phrase aloud to lock in that fluent rhythm.
connectedSpeech.tip: PRO TIP: Say the phrase out loud before you look at the options. Your mouth might already know the answer!
connectedSpeech.title: Connected Speech

consonantClarity.objective: Let's make your consonants crystal clear! Identify the missing sound, then say the word out loud to practice your pronunciation.
consonantClarity.tip: PRO TIP: Pay attention to whether your throat vibrates (voiced) or stays still (voiceless) when you make the sound!
consonantClarity.title: Consonant Clarity

contextClues.objective: Drag the magnifying glass over the blurred text to figure out the missing word. Once you've solved it, tap the exact words in the sentence that gave you the clue!
contextClues.rule_0: Drag the lens to read the text
contextClues.rule_2: Tap the evidence in the sentence
contextClues.tip: PRO TIP: You don't need to know every word! Look for synonyms, opposites, or cause-and-effect clues hiding nearby.
contextClues.title: Context Clues

contextualUsage.objective: Select the word that best fits the sentence's context, then speak the complete sentence aloud to confirm.
contextualUsage.tip: PRO TIP: Pay close attention to the register meter. Sometimes two words mean the same thing, but one is much more formal than the other!
contextualUsage.title: Contextual Usage

correctionWriting.title: Sentence Editor

dailyExpression.objective: Learn the actual, everyday phrases that native speakers use so you can chat confidently and naturally in any situation.
dailyExpression.rule_0: Scratch the card to reveal your phrase
dailyExpression.rule_1: Listen to how it's actually spoken
dailyExpression.tip: PRO TIP: Don't overthink every single word! Focus on the rhythm and the emotion behind the phrase.
dailyExpression.title: Daily Expressions

dailyJournal.objective: Read the prompt and write a short entry about your thoughts or experiences. Doing this regularly helps you build natural writing habits.
dailyJournal.tip: PRO TIP: Don't worry about being perfect. Just focus on getting your thoughts down naturally.
dailyJournal.title: Daily Journal

day_night.objective: Read the clue in the sky, then select the right option to show when it happens.
day_night.tip: PRO TIP: Think about whether the sun is up or the stars are out.
day_night.title: Day and Night

describeSituationWriting.objective: Tap the emojis to reveal your required keywords, then write a short paragraph describing the situation. This is a great way to practice expressing your thoughts clearly in English!
describeSituationWriting.tip: PRO TIP: Tap the emojis first so you know exactly which words you need to include in your paragraph!
describeSituationWriting.title: Describe the Scene

detailSpotlight.objective: Listen closely to the speaker, then wipe the dark glass to uncover the hidden words. Can you find the exact detail they mentioned?
detailSpotlight.tip: PRO TIP: Wipe the glass first so you can see all your options before the timer runs out!
detailSpotlight.title: Detail Spotlight

dialectDrill.objective: English sounds different depending on where you are in the world! Let's train your ears to pick up on those regional differences.
dialectDrill.tip: PRO TIP: Pay attention to the vowels! American English often flattens them, while British English rounds them out.
dialectDrill.title: Dialect Drill

dialogueRoleplay.objective: Conversations are a two-way street! Practice chatting back and forth so you can talk naturally and confidently with anyone, anywhere.
dialogueRoleplay.tip: PRO TIP: Don't worry about being perfect! Just focus on the feeling of the conversation and try to sound as natural as possible.
dialogueRoleplay.title: Dialogue Roleplay

directIndirectSpeech.objective: Someone just said something, and it's your job to report it! First, pick the correct way to pass the message along. Once you get it right, type it out to lock it into your memory.
directIndirectSpeech.rule_2: Type it to lock it in
directIndirectSpeech.tip: PRO TIP: When reporting speech, you usually take a step back in time. So 'I am here' becomes 'they were there'!
directIndirectSpeech.title: Speech Shift

elevatorPitch.objective: The doors are closing! Read the prompt, hit start, and pitch your idea. If you freeze or stop talking for seconds, you lose their attention and fail the pitch.
elevatorPitch.tip: PRO TIP: The listener is judging your fluency and vocabulary. Don't worry about a perfect script, just keep the words flowing!
elevatorPitch.title: Pitch Perfect

emergencyHub.objective: Practice staying calm and speaking clearly when things go wrong. Learning how to deliver critical information fast is one of the best ways to build true fluency under pressure.
emergencyHub.tip: PRO TIP: When you're stressed, you'll naturally speak too fast. Take a breath and focus on hitting every consonant clearly.
emergencyHub.title: Emergency Hub

emotionRecognition.objective: Identify the speaker's emotional state from their pitch and tone. Practicing this trains your ears to understand native speakers effortlessly.
emotionRecognition.tip: PRO TIP: Rhythm, volume spikes, and sighing express more than literal words.
emotionRecognition.title: Sentiment Prober

emotions.objective: Listen to the scenario, understand how the person is feeling, and match the correct emotion mask to the stage.
emotions.rule_2: Match the mask to the stage
emotions.tip: PRO TIP: Think about how you would feel in that exact situation.
emotions.title: Emotions

essayDrafting.objective: Let's put these thoughts into a clear, logical order. A well-structured outline makes all the difference when you're writing.
essayDrafting.rule_0: Look at the empty hex slots to see what's missing.
essayDrafting.rule_1: Grab the sentence cards and drag them into the right slots.
essayDrafting.rule_2: Made a mistake? Just tap a filled slot to send the card back.
essayDrafting.tip: PRO TIP: Use the empty hex slots as clues — they'll tell you exactly what kind of sentence belongs there!
essayDrafting.title: Essay Drafting

family.objective: Match the family member to the description by placing their photo in the frame.
family.tip: PRO TIP: Pay attention to key relationship words like 'parent' or 'sibling'.
family.title: Family

fastSpeechDecoder.objective: Native speakers talk fast and mash words together! Spin the dial to slow them down and figure out exactly what they just said.
fastSpeechDecoder.rule_0: Spin the dial to adjust speed
fastSpeechDecoder.tip: PRO TIP: If you can't catch the words at normal speed, slow it down until you hear every syllable.
fastSpeechDecoder.title: Fast Talkers

findWordMeaning.objective: Read the definition at the top, then tap the exact word in the passage that matches it! It's a great way to build your vocabulary naturally.
findWordMeaning.tip: PRO TIP: If you're stuck, read the whole sentence out loud. You can usually feel which word fits the description best!
findWordMeaning.title: Word Detective

fixTheSentence.objective: Scrub the logical decay and select the correct replacement word. Being able to do this helps you write naturally and clearly in the real world.
fixTheSentence.tip: PRO TIP: Read the sentence out loud in your head! If it sounds clumsy, revise it.
fixTheSentence.title: Clarity Editor

flashcards.objective: Let's challenge your memory! Look at the hint and try to remember what the word means. Once you have a guess, tap the card to see the answer. If you got it right, swipe right. Need more practice? Swipe left.
flashcards.rule_2: Swipe Right for Got It, Left for Again
flashcards.tip: PRO TIP: Honesty is the best policy! If you didn't quite remember it, swipe left. We'll bring it back later so you can try again.
flashcards.title: Vocabulary Flashcards

food.objective: Welcome to the kitchen! Read the food riddle on the board, find the matching ingredient, and place it on the cutting board.
food.tip: PRO TIP: If you get stuck, look closely at the shape or color mentioned in the clue!
food.title: Yummy Food

fruits.objective: Let's run our fruit stand! Look at the fruit shown on the wooden board, then tap or drag the matching basket to serve it.
fruits.rule_0: Look at the fruit on the board
fruits.rule_1: Find the basket with the right name
fruits.rule_2: Tap or drag the basket to match
fruits.tip: PRO TIP: Can't read a word? Just start dragging a basket to hear its name out loud!
fruits.title: Fruit Stand

gourmetOrder.objective: Read the kitchen ticket, drag the correct food to the serving tray, and speak to confirm the order before time runs out!
gourmetOrder.tip: PRO TIP: Double-check the ticket before dragging plates to avoid sending the wrong order.
gourmetOrder.title: Kitchen Rush

grammar.objective: Fix the underlying structural errors to complete the sentence. Practicing this builds your grammar muscle so you do not have to think about the rules anymore.
grammar.tip: PRO TIP: Read the sentence out loud in your head! Often, you can 'hear' if a rule is being broken.
grammar.title: Structural Logic

grammarQuest.objective: Read the grammar rule and tap the compass to pick the correct missing word. Once you find it, type out the full sentence to lock in your answer!
grammarQuest.rule_1: Tap the compass to pick the word
grammarQuest.rule_2: Type the full sentence to lock it in
grammarQuest.tip: PRO TIP: If you're stuck on the compass, read the grammar rule card! It explains exactly how to solve the sentence.
grammarQuest.title: Grammar Quest

guessTitle.objective: Read the story and figure out the main point. Picking the right title proves you understand the whole picture, not just a random detail.
guessTitle.tip: PRO TIP: Don't get tricked by a word that only appeared once. A good title summarizes the entire text!
guessTitle.title: Name That Story

handwriting.objective: Pick up your chalk and practice drawing lines, shapes, and letters right on the chalkboard slate.
handwriting.rule_0: Tap Demo to watch how each stroke is drawn step by step
handwriting.rule_1: Turn on Trace to follow the dotted lines, or practice on your own
handwriting.rule_2: Tap Check My Answer when ready, or use the duster to try again
handwriting.tip: Pro tip: Take your time. Drawing strokes from top to bottom and left to right makes writing so much easier!
handwriting.title: Chalkboard Writing

home.objective: Explore parts of a house, different rooms, daily items, and home safety. Read or listen to each clue and choose the answer.
home.rule_0: Read or listen to the clue
home.rule_1: Tap or drag the matching answer to the house
home.rule_2: Tap the speaker anytime to hear words spoken aloud
home.tip: Tip: Tap any card's speaker to hear how the word is pronounced before answering.
home.title: Home

idiomMatch.objective: Read the short story and choose the idiom that fits perfectly. Then, say it out loud to practice sounding just like a native speaker.
idiomMatch.rule_2: Say it out loud to confirm
idiomMatch.tip: PRO TIP: If you get stuck, try picturing the scene in your head. Idioms are highly visual!
idiomMatch.title: Idiom Master

idiommatch.objective: Match the idiom to its real meaning. Learning these helps you sound much more natural when you talk.
idiommatch.tip: PRO TIP: Idioms rarely mean what the individual words mean literally. Think about the feeling or situation they describe!
idiommatch.title: Idiom Master

idioms.objective: Read the meaning and the emojis, then choose the idiom that matches. Idioms are phrases that don't mean exactly what the words say, and they are used all the time in everyday conversations.
idioms.tip: PRO TIP: Don't translate idioms word-for-word! Think about the overall feeling or situation they describe.
idioms.title: Emojify

intonationMimic.objective: Let's practice the melody of English! First, slide the fader up or down to match the speaker's pitch, then speak the sentence aloud to lock in the rhythm.
intonationMimic.tip: PRO TIP: Pay close attention to the end of the sentence! Questions usually rise, while statements often fall.
intonationMimic.title: Pitch Perfect

jobInterview.objective: Step into the boardroom and practice answering tough interview questions. Choose the most professional response to show them why you're the perfect fit for the team.
jobInterview.tip: PRO TIP: Try to connect your past experience directly to what the company actually needs.
jobInterview.title: The Big Interview

listening.objective: Listen carefully and choose the correct answer option. Practicing this trains your ears to understand native speakers effortlessly.
listening.tip: PRO TIP: Close your eyes! Focusing on pure sound helps catch subtle phoneme changes.
listening.title: Audio Analysis

listeningInference.objective: Listen carefully and figure out what the speaker really means, even if they don't say it directly. This helps you understand real-world English conversations!
listeningInference.tip: PRO TIP: Pay close attention to how the speaker sounds, not just the exact words they use!
listeningInference.title: Inference Lens

medicalConsult.objective: Listen to the patient's complaint and drag the scanner over their holographic body to locate the correct symptom.
medicalConsult.rule_1: Drag the scanner to find the symptom
medicalConsult.tip: PRO TIP: Pay close attention to exactly where the patient says the pain is coming from.
medicalConsult.title: Medical Consult

minimalPairs.objective: Listen closely to the word and pick the right matching sound. Catching these subtle differences is the secret to sounding totally natural.
minimalPairs.rule_1: Notice how long the vowel is held
minimalPairs.tip: PRO TIP: Does the vowel sound short and clipped, or is it drawn out? That's usually the key!
minimalPairs.title: Minimal Pairs

modalsSelection.objective: Pick the right word to set the mood! Words like 'can', 'should', and 'might' completely change the feeling of a sentence.
modalsSelection.rule_1: Is it a rule or advice?
modalsSelection.tip: PRO TIP: Use 'must' for rules you have to follow, and 'should' when you're just giving friendly advice.
modalsSelection.title: Modal Match

modifierPlacement.objective: Let's practice placing describing words (like adjectives and adverbs) exactly where they belong so your sentences are perfectly clear.
modifierPlacement.tip: PRO TIP: Place the describing word as close as possible to the thing it's describing!
modifierPlacement.title: Modifier Map

nature.objective: Explore living things, weather, seasons, and habitats. Read or listen to the clue on the tree sign, then choose the matching answer on the stones.
nature.rule_0: Read or listen to the clue on the tree sign
nature.rule_1: Tap or drag the matching stone to answer
nature.rule_2: Tap any stone's speaker to hear it spoken aloud
nature.tip: Tip: Tap the speaker icon on any stone to hear how the word is pronounced before choosing.
nature.title: Nature

numbers.objective: Look through your rocket window to count the items, then choose the planet that matches to help your spaceship fly!
numbers.rule_0: Look at the pictures or numbers in the rocket window
numbers.rule_1: Tap a planet or drag it up to your rocket to answer
numbers.rule_2: Tap the speaker button any time you want to hear the numbers out loud
numbers.tip: Helpful tip: You can tap each item on the screen with your finger while counting out loud so you never lose your place!
numbers.title: Numbers in Space

opinionWriting.objective: Read the situation carefully, then tap or drag the best ideas onto your drafting pad to build a strong, clear argument.
opinionWriting.rule_2: Tap or drag to the pad
opinionWriting.tip: PRO TIP: Pay close attention to the goal! Sometimes you need just one strong point, other times you need a few ideas to back it up.
opinionWriting.title: Opinion Writing

opposites.objective: Look at the clue word, think of its opposite, and tap or drag the matching word to complete the pair.
opposites.rule_0: Read or listen to the clue word
opposites.rule_1: Tap or drag the matching opposite word
opposites.rule_2: Tap any speaker to hear words spoken aloud
opposites.tip: Tip: Tap any card's speaker to hear how the word sounds before choosing.
opposites.title: Opposites

paragraphSummary.objective: Read the passage, squeeze the tube to distill the core keywords, and use them to pick the perfect summary! This trains you to instantly spot the main idea in real life.
paragraphSummary.tip: PRO TIP: Squeezing the tube reveals the most important keywords. Let them guide you to the right answer!
paragraphSummary.title: Paragraph Summary

partsOfSpeech.objective: Read the sentence and figure out what job the highlighted word is doing. Does it show an action? A thing? A description?
partsOfSpeech.rule_2: Sort it into the right category
partsOfSpeech.tip: PRO TIP: Always read the whole sentence first! A word like 'run' can be a noun or a verb depending on how it's used.
partsOfSpeech.title: Parts of Speech

phonics.objective: Listen to the sound clue, check the word or letters on the speaker, and choose the matching sound to complete the word.
phonics.tip: Say the sound out loud as you listen—it helps your brain connect letters to real words!
phonics.title: Sound Match

phrasalVerbs.objective: Phrasal verbs are tricky combinations like 'turn up' or 'break down'. Read the clue, choose the missing word to crack the vault, and then speak the full sentence aloud.
phrasalVerbs.tip: PRO TIP: The second word changes everything! 'Turn up' (increase) means something totally different than 'turn down' (refuse).
phrasalVerbs.title: Verb Vault

pitchModulation.objective: Listen to the speaker and slide the dial to match their pitch pattern. Getting this right helps you express emotion naturally when you speak!
pitchModulation.tip: PRO TIP: Does their voice go up at the end, or down? That usually gives away the right answer!
pitchModulation.title: Pitch Modulation

pitchPatternMatch.objective: Listen to the sentence and figure out where the speaker puts the most emphasis. Nailing the pitch helps you express your exact meaning when speaking!
pitchPatternMatch.tip: PRO TIP: Pay attention to where the voice climbs the highest. Is it on the subject, or the action?
pitchPatternMatch.title: Melody Syncer

prefixSuffix.objective: Did you know that adding just a few tiny letters can completely change a word's meaning? Choose the right prefix or suffix to build the target word, and then type it out to lock it in.
prefixSuffix.tip: PRO TIP: Pay close attention to the clues! If the meaning says 'again', look for 're-'. If it says 'without', try '-less'.
prefixSuffix.title: Prefixes & Suffixes

prepositionChoice.objective: Drag the energy beam to the correct preposition! Once you connect it, type the full sentence out to lock it into your memory.
prepositionChoice.rule_0: Trace the path to the right word
prepositionChoice.rule_2: Type the sentence to lock it in
prepositionChoice.tip: PRO TIP: Prepositions usually follow patterns! If you're not sure, try saying the sentence out loud — your ears will often catch the right one.
prepositionChoice.title: Path Finder

prepositions.objective: Read or listen to the sentence, find where the object is, and choose the correct position word to complete the blank.
prepositions.rule_0: Read or listen to the sentence clue
prepositions.rule_1: Tap or drag the matching preposition to the blank
prepositions.rule_2: Tap any speaker icon to hear the words spoken aloud
prepositions.tip: Tip: Words like 'in', 'on', and 'under' tell you exactly where things are placed.
prepositions.title: Where Is It?

professions.objective: Read the clue on the board to find out who can help, then tap or drag the right helper to solve it!
professions.rule_0: Read the clue on the board
professions.rule_1: Tap or drag the helper who fits the job
professions.rule_2: Tap the speaker to hear any word aloud
professions.tip: Tip: Tap the Listen button if you want to hear the clue read aloud!
professions.title: Community Helpers

pronounResolution.objective: Select the correct pronoun that clearly resolves the sentence. Practicing this builds your grammar muscle so you do not have to think about the rules anymore.
pronounResolution.tip: PRO TIP: If there are two people, 'he' can be confusing. Use their names or clear markers!
pronounResolution.title: Pronoun Pivot

pronunciationFocus.objective: Train your mouth muscles to master tricky English sounds. By shadowing the native speaker and comparing your voice, you'll naturally eliminate your accent and speak with confidence.
pronunciationFocus.tip: PRO TIP: Tap the 'Position Guide' to see exactly how to move your lips and tongue!
pronunciationFocus.title: Pronunciation Focus

punctuationMastery.objective: Drag and drop the missing punctuation to complete the sentence. Good punctuation ensures others read your writing exactly the way you meant it to be read!
punctuationMastery.tip: PRO TIP: If you're ever stuck, try reading the sentence out loud to find where the natural pauses are!
punctuationMastery.title: Punctuation Mastery

questionFormatter.objective: Arrange words or choose forms to create an accurate question. Practicing this builds your grammar muscle so you do not have to think about the rules anymore.
questionFormatter.tip: PRO TIP: Remember the 'Qu-A-S-V' rule: Question word, Auxiliary, Subject, Verb!
questionFormatter.title: Inquiry Logic

readAndAnswer.objective: Read the story and hunt down the key facts to answer the questions. It's a great way to train your brain to catch important details quickly!
readAndAnswer.tip: PRO TIP: Skim the question first so you know exactly what facts to look for while you read!
readAndAnswer.title: Fact Finder

readAndMatch.objective: Connect the words on the left to their correct meanings on the right. It's a simple way to pick up new vocabulary.
readAndMatch.rule_0: Tap a word on the left
readAndMatch.rule_1: Tap its meaning on the right
readAndMatch.tip: PRO TIP: Not sure about a word? Match the easy ones first to leave fewer choices at the end.
readAndMatch.title: Read & Match

reading.objective: Read the passage carefully and answer the comprehension questions. Mastering reading comprehension allows you to quickly extract key information in the real world.
reading.tip: PRO TIP: Scan for keywords first! Don't get stuck on one word; focus on the overall message.
reading.title: Text Comprehension

readingConclusion.objective: Read the short story and figure out what happens next. Tap the best answer based on the clues!
readingConclusion.tip: PRO TIP: Don't just guess! The clues you need are hiding right there in the text.
readingConclusion.title: Logical Leap

readingInference.objective: Wipe away the fog to read the story, figure out what is really going on, and then highlight the exact words that prove it! This trains your brain to pick up on hidden clues naturally.
readingInference.rule_0: Wipe the fog to reveal the text
readingInference.rule_1: Read between the lines and guess what's happening
readingInference.rule_2: Highlight the exact words that prove your guess
readingInference.tip: PRO TIP: You can clear the fog much faster by dragging your finger across the text instead of just tapping!
readingInference.title: Hidden Truth

readingSpeedCheck.objective: Read the text quickly, stop the timer, and answer a question to check your understanding. It's a fun way to train yourself to read English faster!
readingSpeedCheck.tip: PRO TIP: When you're done reading, tap 'Stop Timer' right away. The faster you read, the higher your WPM score!
readingSpeedCheck.title: Speed Reader

relativeClauses.objective: Tap or drag to connect the sentence halves! We'll use words like 'who' and 'which' to stitch extra details smoothly into your thoughts.
relativeClauses.tip: PRO TIP: If you're talking about a person, always use 'Who'. If it's an object or an animal, 'Which' is your best bet!
relativeClauses.title: Relative Rail

repeatSentence.objective: Listen carefully to the native speaker and try to mimic their exact pronunciation, rhythm, and tone. This technique, called shadowing, is the fastest way to build natural speaking habits.
repeatSentence.tip: PRO TIP: Don't just read the words — try to copy the speaker's emotion and melody exactly!
repeatSentence.title: Echo Master

roleplay.objective: Have a real conversation! Listen to what your partner says, choose a natural response, and speak it out loud to practice your pronunciation.
roleplay.tip: PRO TIP: Stuck? Tap a chip to see some ideas, and use the speaker icon to hear how a native would say it!
roleplay.title: Roleplay Partner

routine.objective: Match daily routines to the right time of day. Read or listen to the clue, look outside the window, and choose the routine that fits best.
routine.rule_0: Read or listen to the clue at the top
routine.rule_1: Look outside the window to see the time of day
routine.rule_2: Tap or drag the matching routine pillow to the window
routine.tip: Tip: Tap the speaker on any pillow to hear the routine words out loud before you choose!
routine.title: Daily Routines

sceneDescriptionSpeaking.objective: Explore the environment and describe what you find! Tapping hotspots and naming objects out loud is a great way to train your brain to recall everyday English words faster.
sceneDescriptionSpeaking.tip: PRO TIP: Take your time. Don't worry about making a perfect sentence right away; just focus on hitting the key words naturally.
sceneDescriptionSpeaking.title: Scene Radar

school.objective: Read or listen to the teacher's classroom clue, then choose or place the matching answer on the desk.
school.rule_0: Read or listen to the clue on the chalkboard
school.rule_1: Tap your answer or drag it onto the desk
school.rule_2: Tap any card's speaker to hear the word pronounced aloud
school.tip: Tip: Tap the Listen button on the board anytime to hear the teacher's clue again.
school.title: School Days

sentenceBuilder.objective: Put the scrambled words in the right order to make a complete sentence. This trains your brain to naturally feel how English flows without overthinking the grammar.
sentenceBuilder.tip: PRO TIP: Try to find who or what the sentence is about first, then look for the action!
sentenceBuilder.title: Sentence Builder

sentenceCorrection.objective: Read the sentence and find the mistake. Tap the wrong word, pick the right repair option, and then type out the final sentence to confirm it.
sentenceCorrection.tip: PRO TIP: Read the sentence out loud! If something sounds a bit awkward or unnatural, that's usually where the mistake is hidden.
sentenceCorrection.title: Sentence Correction

sentenceOrderReading.objective: Put the mixed-up sentences back in the right order. This trains your brain to understand how English stories naturally connect.
sentenceOrderReading.tip: PRO TIP: Look for transition words like 'Because', 'Next', or 'Finally' to see exactly how the sentences link together.
sentenceOrderReading.title: Story Flow

shadowingChallenge.objective: Let's figure out how native speakers actually talk! Listen closely to the sentence, pick the correct pronunciation habit you hear, and then try saying it yourself.
shadowingChallenge.tip: PRO TIP: Try saying the sentence aloud exactly as you hear it. Feeling how the words connect in your mouth will make picking the right rule much easier!
shadowingChallenge.title: Shadowing Challenge

shapes.objective: Look at the clue and picture to find the matching shape, then tap or drag the block to answer.
shapes.rule_0: Read or listen to the shape clue
shapes.rule_1: Tap or drag the matching shape block to answer
shapes.rule_2: Tap any block's speaker to hear the shape name out loud
shapes.tip: Tip: Count the sides and corners to help you find the right shape!
shapes.title: Shapes

shortAnswerWriting.objective: Read the context and write a single, natural sentence using all the provided keywords. This helps you build the habit of forming complete thoughts in English.
shortAnswerWriting.tip: PRO TIP: Don't overthink it! Just write the way you would normally speak.
shortAnswerWriting.title: Short Answer

situationSpeaking.objective: Step into real-world situations and practice exactly what you'd say to a native speaker. Read the scenario, think of your answer, and hold the microphone to speak!
situationSpeaking.rule_1: Use the hint if you get stuck
situationSpeaking.rule_2: Hold the mic and speak naturally
situationSpeaking.tip: PRO TIP: Take a deep breath and imagine you are actually there. There's no timer, so take your time to build the perfect sentence.
situationSpeaking.title: Situation Speaking

situationalResponse.objective: Read the scenario, pick the most natural response, and speak it out loud. It's a great way to practice thinking on your feet!
situationalResponse.tip: PRO TIP: Once you've chosen your answer, speak it clearly and naturally — just like in a real conversation.
situationalResponse.title: Situational Response

skimmingScanning.objective: Read quickly and tap the exact target word before the timer runs out! Don't let the clock beat you.
skimmingScanning.tip: PRO TIP: Keep your eyes moving! Don't read every single word — just scan for the one you need and tap it fast.
skimmingScanning.title: Information Scanner

socialSpark.objective: Let's practice starting and keeping a conversation going naturally! Tap the floating words in the right order to build your response, then speak it out loud to practice your flow.
socialSpark.tip: PRO TIP: Smiling while you speak actually makes your voice sound much friendlier!
socialSpark.title: Social Spark

soundImageMatch.objective: Tap the speaker to hear the sentence, then quickly pick the matching picture before the -second timer runs out!
soundImageMatch.tip: PRO TIP: Don't translate everything in your head! Just listen for the main object or action.
soundImageMatch.title: Listen & Match

speakMissingWord.objective: Listen to the sentence and tap the right word to fill the blank. Once it's locked in, repeat the entire sentence out loud to master your pronunciation!
speakMissingWord.rule_0: Tap to pick the missing word
speakMissingWord.rule_2: Speak it out loud to practice
speakMissingWord.tip: PRO TIP: When you repeat the sentence, try to mimic the native speaker's rhythm and emotion perfectly!
speakMissingWord.title: Speak Missing Word

speakOpposite.objective: Say the exact opposite of the highlighted word! Practicing opposites out loud is a fantastic way to train your brain to recall English words faster.
speakOpposite.tip: PRO TIP: Use the hint sentence if you get stuck! It shows you exactly how the word is used in real life.
speakOpposite.title: Speak the Opposite

speakSynonym.objective: Say a different word that means the exact same thing. Having multiple words for the same idea makes your speaking much more interesting and natural!
speakSynonym.tip: PRO TIP: Keep it simple! You don't need to use big fancy words — everyday words work perfectly.
speakSynonym.title: Synonym Challenge

speaking.objective: Tap mic and repeat the phrase clearly at a natural pace. Mastering this skill ensures your spoken English sounds clear and natural in real-world conversations.
speaking.tip: PRO TIP: Record yourself! Comparing your pitch to the model helps master the natural rhythm.
speaking.title: Voice Mastery

speedSpelling.objective: Tap the floating letters to spell the word correctly. Doing this helps you remember how to write words perfectly in real life.
speedSpelling.tip: PRO TIP: Say the word out loud before you start tapping. It really helps!
speedSpelling.title: Speed Spelling

speedVariance.objective: Native speakers change their speed based on how they feel! Listen to the audio and figure out why the speaker is talking so fast or slow.
speedVariance.tip: PRO TIP: Don't just listen to the words, listen to the emotion! Is it an emergency? Or are they spelling out an email?
speedVariance.title: Speed Variance

speedspelling.objective: Tap the floating letters to spell the word correctly. Doing this helps you remember how to write words perfectly in real life.
speedspelling.tip: PRO TIP: Sound the word out slowly in your head before tapping the letters.
speedspelling.title: Speed Spelling

storyBuilder.objective: Put the scrambled sentences in the right order to build a complete story. Practicing this helps you write and speak much more naturally in real life.
storyBuilder.rule_2: Read the story aloud at the end
storyBuilder.tip: PRO TIP: Look for transition words like 'However' or 'Therefore' to see how the sentences connect!
storyBuilder.title: Story Builder

storybuilder.objective: Put the scrambled sentences in the right order to build a complete story. Practicing this helps you write and speak much more naturally in real life.
storybuilder.rule_2: Read the story aloud at the end
storybuilder.tip: PRO TIP: Look for transition words like 'However' or 'Therefore' to see how the sentences connect!
storybuilder.title: Story Builder

subjectVerbAgreement.objective: Drag the Quantum Core to the correct verb terminal to complete the sentence! Matching subjects and verbs perfectly is the key to sounding natural.
subjectVerbAgreement.rule_1: Drag the core to the matching verb
subjectVerbAgreement.rule_2: Release to lock in your answer!
subjectVerbAgreement.tip: PRO TIP: Watch out for sneaky 'distractor' words! Prepositional phrases between the subject and verb can trick you.
subjectVerbAgreement.title: Agreement Sync

summarizeStoryWriting.objective: Read the story, then drag the most important events into the correct order to build a short summary. Once you're done, you'll type it out to lock it in!
summarizeStoryWriting.rule_1: Drag the main events in order
summarizeStoryWriting.tip: PRO TIP: Watch out for trick sentences! A good summary only includes the main points, not every single detail.
summarizeStoryWriting.title: Story Summary

syllableStress.objective: Listen closely to the word and tap the drum pad that matches the stressed syllable. Getting this right is the secret to sounding totally natural in conversation!
syllableStress.tip: PRO TIP: The stressed syllable usually sounds a bit louder, longer, and clearer than the rest of the word!
syllableStress.title: Stress Spotter

synonymSearch.objective: Find the word that means the exact same thing! Drag the correct shard into the center gate, then read the sentence out loud to see how the word naturally fits in conversation.
synonymSearch.tip: PRO TIP: Synonyms often have slightly different feelings to them. Reading the hint will help you pick the perfect one!
synonymSearch.title: Synonym Warp

tenseMastery.rule_2: Type to lock in your answer
tenseMastery.tip: PRO TIP: Look for hidden time clues! Words like 'yesterday' belong in the Past, 'now' means Present, and 'tomorrow' points to the Future.
tenseMastery.title: Tense Mastery

time.objective: Look at the clock or listen to the daily clue, then pick the matching time or part of the day.

time.rule_1: Tap an answer or drag it right to the clock
time.rule_2: Tap the speaker anytime to hear the clue again

time.title: Telling Time

topicVocab.objective: Flick the vocabulary word into the correct containment bin based on its topic. Grouping words helps you recall them faster during real-world conversations.

level_100.objective: Congratulations on reaching Level 100! You've learned so many ways we travel around our world. Let's solve this milestone travel challenge together!

level_100.rule_1: Tap or drag the matching vehicle to answer
level_100.tip: Tip: You know vehicles that travel by land, sea, and air. Trust your skills and enjoy this special milestone!
level_100.title: Century Traveler!

transport.objective: Explore vehicles and ways to travel! Read or listen to the clue on the highway sign, then choose the matching vehicle.
transport.rule_0: Read or listen to the clue on the highway sign
transport.rule_1: Tap or drag the matching vehicle to answer
transport.rule_2: Tap any card's speaker to hear the word pronounced
transport.tip: Tip: Think about where each vehicle travels—on the road, in the water, or in the air!
transport.title: Zoom Zoom!

travelDesk.objective: Listen to the traveler's request and stamp their biometric passport with the correct destination. Make sure you don't send them to the wrong place!
travelDesk.tip: PRO TIP: Pay attention to key words in the traveler's request to identify exactly what they need.
travelDesk.title: Customs Officer

trueFalseReading.objective: Read a short story, then flick the Truth Coin to decide if the statement is true or false. But you can't just guess — you have to highlight the exact sentence that proves you're right!
trueFalseReading.rule_0: Flick the True or False coin
trueFalseReading.tip: PRO TIP: Watch out for absolute words like 'always' or 'never' — they usually mean a statement is false.
trueFalseReading.title: Fact Checker

level_100.objective: Congratulations on reaching Level 100! You've learned so many action words for what people and animals do. Let's score this milestone action challenge together!
level_100.rule_0: Read or listen to the story clue on the scoreboard
level_100.rule_1: Tap or throw the matching sports ball into the stadium
level_100.tip: Tip: Action words tell what someone is doing, like jump, throw, cook, or swim. You're an action champion!
level_100.title: Action Champion!

verbs.objective: Read or listen to the action story on the scoreboard, then find the sports ball with the matching action word.
verbs.rule_0: Read or listen to the story clue on the scoreboard
verbs.rule_1: Tap your answer or drag the ball into the stadium
verbs.rule_2: Tap any speaker icon to hear the action words spoken aloud
verbs.tip: Tip: A verb is an action word that tells what someone is doing, like run, jump, or play.
verbs.title: Action Time!

vocabulary.objective: Match words to their correct definitions to expand your vocabulary. Learning these helps you sound much more natural when you talk.
vocabulary.tip: PRO TIP: Visual associations help! Try to link the word to a picture in your mind.
vocabulary.title: Word Power

voiceSwap.objective: Learn when to put the doer in the spotlight (Active) or focus on the action itself (Passive). Flip the voice, then type the new sentence to lock it in!
voiceSwap.tip: PRO TIP: In Passive voice, the object becomes the star! You can often drop 'by [someone]' if it doesn't matter who did it.
voiceSwap.title: Voice Swap

vowelDistinction.objective: Vowels can be tricky! Listen to the native speaker, slide the fader to pick the right sound, and then say the word out loud to confirm it.
vowelDistinction.tip: PRO TIP: Don't just listen — pay attention to the mouth shape in the chart! It'll help you pronounce it perfectly.
vowelDistinction.title: Vowel Distinction

weather.objective: Look outside the window and read the clue, then tap or drag the matching weather to solve it!
weather.rule_0: Read or listen to the weather clue
weather.rule_2: Drag it to the window or tap to choose
weather.tip: Tip: Picture what you see outside, or tap the speaker to hear the clue read aloud!
weather.title: Weather Window

wordFormation.objective: Native speakers naturally adapt words to fit different situations. Read the clue, choose the correct ending to build your new word, and type it out to confirm!
wordFormation.tip: PRO TIP: Ask yourself what kind of word you need. Are you turning a noun into an adjective, or a verb into a person?
wordFormation.title: Word Builder

wordLinking.objective: Native speakers don't pause between every word. They link sounds together to create a smooth, continuous flow. Your goal is to identify exactly where this happens.
wordLinking.rule_1: Tap the link between the words
wordLinking.tip: PRO TIP: If a word ends in a consonant and the next starts with a vowel, they usually merge into one smooth sound.
wordLinking.title: Word Linking

wordReorder.objective: First, tap the words to build a natural-sounding English sentence. Once you get it right, type it out to lock it into your muscle memory!
wordReorder.tip: PRO TIP: Look for capital letters to find the first word, and punctuation for the last!
wordReorder.title: Sentence Builder

writing.objective: Arrange the words in the correct order to build a complete sentence. Being able to do this helps you write naturally and clearly in the real world.
writing.tip: PRO TIP: Start with the verb! Finding the action helps the rest of the sentence fall into place.
writing.title: Sentence Construction

writingEmail.objective: Learn how to structure real-world emails by putting the subject, greeting, body, and sign-off in the right order.
writingEmail.tip: PRO TIP: Always read the prompt to know who you are writing to! A friend gets a casual 'Hi', while a boss gets a formal 'Dear'.
writingEmail.title: Email Builder

yesNoSpeaking.objective: Answer the factual questions firmly with a spoken 'Yes' or 'No'. Mastering this skill ensures your spoken English sounds clear and natural in real-world conversations.
yesNoSpeaking.tip: PRO TIP: Speak with confident, clear pronunciation directly into the mic.
yesNoSpeaking.title: Voice Validator
